experiments.name: Google Forms switcher page and Search pilot
experiments.hypothesis: A factual comparison will attract switchers; paid conversion remains unverified and the supplied funnel rates are assumptions.
experiments.population: Google Forms users searching for branded links, partial answers, or question-level drop-off.
experiments.primaryMetric: Paid accounts per 100 qualified visits; signup rate is an early signal.
guardrails: Baseline: export prior-90-day switcher visits, signups, and paid upgrades by day 7; label unavailable data unknown.
Portfolio assumptions: 1–5% visitor-to-signup and 5–15% signup-to-paid; 100 visits imply about 1–5 signups and 0.05–0.75 paid accounts.
A/B sample need ≈ 16p(1−p)/d² visitors per arm; baseline p and detectable difference d are unknown, so this pilot is directional.
Cap spend at $60; stop at 100 qualified visits or 21 days, whichever comes first.
Confounds: query mix, ranking, seasonality, and concurrent page changes; log these and avoid other page edits.
experiments.stoppingRule: At 100 visits: kill zero signups; scale at ≥5 signups and 1 paid; otherwise revise once.

experiments.name: Agency intake outreach pilot
experiments.hypothesis: Personalized outreach about AI-built intake and direct Stripe payments may earn agency bookings and paid accounts.
experiments.population: 300 Clutch-listed owner-led web and design agencies with published business emails.
experiments.primaryMetric: Paid agency accounts per 300 delivered; replies and bookings are early signals.
guardrails: Baseline: export prior-90-day outreach results if available; otherwise the business baseline is unknown.
ClimbOS grade-B estimates: 1–3% replies (3–9/300); 20–40% of replies book (0.6–3.6 bookings).
Assumption: 10–25% booked-to-paid yields 0.06–0.9 paid accounts; validate by day 21. Results are directional.
Pause above the 2% bounce guardrail from experiment-design guidance; check each batch.
Include opt-out; stop follow-ups on any reply or opt-out. List quality and deliverability are confounds.
experiments.stoppingRule: At 300 delivered: kill below 3 replies; scale only after 2 bookings and 1 paid.

constraints: Paid-ad ceiling: $600/month; initial Search pilot capped at $60; remaining spend held pending CAC fit.
Owner marketing time is unknown; assume two hours weekly until confirmed by day 3.
Weekly owner allocation: 30 minutes approvals; 30 minutes scorecard and replies; 60 minutes calls and closing.
Export actual gross margin, paid-seat mix, and account size from billing and costs by day 7.
Assume three-month payback, the SaaS playbook default; confirm or reset it by day 7.
Search geography is unspecified; confirm eligible markets before launching ads or outreach.
ClimbOS researches prospects, personalizes published business emails, sends from the owner’s mailbox, and follows up twice.
Pilot outreach: 300 agencies over 21 days, sent at 100 weekly; scale to 200 weekly only after passing.
output.measurementPlan: By day 7, export prior-90-day traffic, source, signup, activation, paid upgrades, seats, and billing; mark unavailable baselines unknown. UTMs, a source question, and a weekly scorecard track account-level CAC. Separate AI referrals and run monthly prompt checks.

plays.name: Google Forms switcher pages
plays.oneLiner: Turn Formkit’s existing comparison into a useful page for Google Forms switchers.
plays.audience: Google Forms users searching for alternatives on Google Search.
plays.trigger: A user needs a branded link, partial answers, or question drop-off.
plays.hook: Compare Formkit’s free plan, partial responses, and question drop-off with Google Forms.
plays.mechanic: Factual comparison page plus high-intent search ads.
funnel: 600–1,200 visits (assumption, D); visitor→signup 1–5% [practitioner estimate, D]; signup→paid 5–15% (assumption, D).
plays.biggestUnknown: Qualified search volume and free-to-paid conversion.
plays.test: Publish one page; cap search ads at $60; stop at 100 visits or day 21.
plays.killIf: Zero signups per 100 visits, or $60 spent without 100 qualified visits.
plays.scaleIf: At least 5 signups and 1 paid account per 100 visits; publish two pages weekly.
plays.firstActionToday: Approve the Google Forms comparison outline and search-ad group.
plays.climbosCanDo: Draft and publish two comparison pages weekly; track visits, signups, and paid accounts.

plays.name: Agency intake outreach
plays.oneLiner: Reach agencies with an AI-built intake and direct-payment workflow.
plays.audience: Owner-led web and design agencies listed on Clutch.
plays.trigger: An agency needs client intake or paid booking forms.
plays.hook: Create intake forms in Claude; send paid bookings directly to your Stripe account.
plays.mechanic: Personal email with two follow-ups; stop on reply.
plays.assetUsed: Claude and ChatGPT form creation; direct Stripe payments.
funnel: 2,400 emails; reply 1–3% [ClimbOS benchmark, B]; reply→booking 20–40% [ClimbOS benchmark, B]; booking→paid 10–25% (assumption, D).
plays.biggestUnknown: Agency booking-to-paid conversion and account size.
plays.test: Email 300 Clutch-listed agencies; 21 days; no ad spend.
plays.killIf: Fewer than 3 replies from 300 delivered emails by day 21.
plays.scaleIf: At least 2 bookings and 1 paid account; send 200 contacts weekly.
plays.firstActionToday: Choose 30 Clutch agencies and approve the outreach angle.
plays.climbosCanDo: Find published business emails, personalize outreach, and send 200 weekly from the owner’s mailbox.

output.portfolioNote: Run the comparison-page engine and agency outreach together. Combined P50 is about 5 paying customers in 90 days; the paid-conversion assumptions are unverified, so confidence is low.

basic.topIssue: The five-customer forecast depends on unexplained traffic growth and agency account economics, without a credible acquisition-to-upgrade path for a $6-per-seat product.
